writing.exampleCaption: The two ranges have different upper-bound rules.
writing.explanation: The range 0..3 contains 0, 1, and 2; its upper bound is excluded. The inclusive form 1..=3 also contains 3. Half-open ranges fit indexing because a length can be used directly as the excluded end. Inclusive ranges are useful when both endpoints belong to the domain.
writing.feedback: The upper bound of .. is excluded, so 5 is not part of the range.
